description: Adds frames onto an existing clip. Feed the source video (optionally a prompt to steer the new motion); add an End Image to turn the extension into a transition.

input_slots.label: Source Video
input_slots.description: The clip to extend. New frames are generated to continue it.

input_slots.label: End Image (optional)
input_slots.description: If set, the extension morphs toward this frame, making a transition.

prompt.label: Prompt
prompt.description: Optional — describe how the clip should continue / move.

aspect_ratio.label: Aspect Ratio
aspect_ratio.description: Output aspect ratio. 'auto' keeps the source ratio.

guidance_scale.label: Guidance Scale
guidance_scale.description: Prompt adherence. ~9 when steering with an image, ~5 for text-only.
